title: fix(formula,core,react): a template formatter locale rides a reserved context channel, never a root
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGSSiXPYtWQirMK53tWA8Qo)_

Fixes #26232

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The `template` dialect's formatters used to read their locale from `ctx.extra.locale`, the same bag every caller passes the template's author-visible roots in. A root named `locale` (a bulk param, a flow variable) therefore set the formatter locale of the whole sentence, and no caller passed the viewer's locale, so every viewer read `en-US`.

- **`@objectstack/formula`**: `EvalContext.locale?: string` is a reserved channel, like `timezone`: not bound as a variable, never set by a root. `templateEngine.evaluate` reads its formatter locale from it alone (`en-US` when unset or empty). The undeclared `(ctx as { locale }).locale` read it already had becomes the declared, only rung; the `extra.locale` rung is gone.
- **`@object-ui/core`**: `fillTemplateHoles(source, roots, locale?)` passes `locale` on that channel, apart from the roots. `ActionRunner.setDisplayLocale(read)` installs where the runner reads the viewer's locale, read per fill; `confirmText` and `successMessage` format in it, and a `callContext` dispatch (`scopedTo`) keeps it.
- **`@object-ui/react`**: `ActionProvider` and `useActionRunner` install `useDisplayLocale()` beside the translator (`useActionRunnerDisplayLocale`, same latest-ref pattern), so there is no second copy of the locale resolution and a locale switch reaches an already-built runner.
- **`@objectstack/service-automation`**: comment only. `renderTextSlot`'s doc said a flow variable named `locale` was also the formatters' locale; under the ruling it is a value like any other, so the line now says that.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/{core,react}.json` re-recorded (`node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`); one changeset (`patch` ×4, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

## Red first (base `9598405ec`)

Probe through `templateEngine.evaluate` on `origin/main`, source `Set {{ amount | number:2 }} on {{ count }} records, due {{ due | date:long }}`:

```text
no locale root      : "Set 1,234,567.50 on 1200 records, due May 6, 2031"
root named locale   : "Set 1.234.567,50 on 1200 records, due 6. Mai 2031"    (extra.locale = 'de-DE')
ctx.locale zh-CN    : "Set 1,234,567.50 on 1200 records, due 2031年5月6日"
```

The root sets the formatter locale; and the console filler passed only `{ extra: roots }`, so no viewer locale was ever reached.

## Every caller that passed `extra.locale` (measured)

`git grep` for `templateEngine`, `ExpressionEngine.evaluate`, `fillTemplateHoles`, `renderTextSlot` and `formatValue` callers at base:

- `ui/packages/core` `fillTemplateHoles` (ActionRunner `confirmMessage` / `composeSuccessMessage`, plugin-grid `bulkConfirmText`): roots only, no locale. Now the runner passes its display locale.
- `service-automation` `renderTextSlot`: flow variables as `extra`, documented as the locale channel. No engine code sets a flow variable named `locale` and no example or package flow declares one (`git grep` of `name: 'locale'` under `examples`, `apps`, `packages/qa`: 0 hits). Under the ruling it stays a value; flow text formats in `en-US`.
- `packages/formula/src/template-formatters.test.ts`: the one caller that set the locale via `extra: { locale: 'en-US' }`; now `locale: 'en-US'`.
- Registry callers (`seed-eval`, objectql defaults and formula fields, plugin-approvals, plugin-sharing, automation conditions) pass no `locale` in `extra`. `formatValue` (plugin-email) takes `opts.locale` and is untouched.

## Clause-② from the diff

`yes`: `EvalContext` gains an optional member and `fillTemplateHoles` an optional argument (public surface grows). `(narrowing)`: a caller that set the formatter locale through a root (`extra: { locale }`, a flow variable or bulk param named `locale`) now formats in `en-US`, and its value prints only where a hole names it. In-repo producers of that: 0 outside the one test above. A template that names no `locale` root and is evaluated with no locale renders exactly as before (pinned).

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/template-engine.test.ts` (new block): the context locale formats; a root named `locale` prints and does not format (alone, and beside a context locale); no or empty locale is `en-US`. `formula` package: 53 files / 1427 tests pass; `typecheck` exit 0.
- `service-automation/src/builtin/text-slot-template.test.ts`: a flow variable named `locale` prints and formats in `en-US`. Package: 207 files / 2699 tests pass; `typecheck` exit 0.
- `ui/packages/core/.../ActionRunner.copyTemplateLocale-26232.test.ts`: `fillTemplateHoles` root vs argument; the runner's `confirmText` with and without a display locale, read per fill, kept across a `callContext`; `successMessage`. Core: 213 files / 4097 pass, 27 skipped; `type-check` exit 0.
- `ui/packages/react/.../ActionProvider.copyTemplateLocale-26232.test.tsx`: real `I18nProvider` + `LocalizationProvider` + `ActionProvider` / `useActionRunner`: tenant locale reaches the toast and the confirm; with no tenant locale the UI language does, and a language switch reaches the same runner. React: 120 files / 1483 pass; `type-check` exit 0.
- plugin-grid bulk suites (the other `fillTemplateHoles` caller): 27 files / 264 pass.
- Expected strings are computed with `Intl` in each test (no ICU drift between the container's Node and CI's).

**Ablation** (head `7f9627df`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, formula tests import `./template-engine` from `src`): put back the `extra.locale` rung ahead of `ctx.locale` → `a root named locale is a value a hole prints, not the formatter locale` FAILS (1 failed / 10 passed); restored, blob `a2e9acd8fba9` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (local, head `6507217d8`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 72 commands, every one exit 0 except: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 on the shallow clone (fetched its control `621a4876`, rerun exit 0); `check-sdui-manifest` exit 1 until the re-record (rerun exit 0); `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 before a full build (rerun after the full build, below). Lint (`eslint` on the 13 touched TS files, `--no-inline-config`): 0 errors, 29 warnings, the same set the base versions carry. Full build, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:dts-closure` and the full dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm) are in the os-dev report on the card.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not wired here: the bulk confirm dialog.** `BulkActionDialog` → `bulkConfirmText` → `fillTemplateHoles` still passes no locale, because open draft #26217 (#25942 step 2) rewrites exactly those two files. The hijack is closed for it by the engine change; reaching the viewer's locale there is one argument (`useDisplayLocale()` into `fillTemplateHoles`'s third parameter) once #26217 lands.
- Flow text slots format in `en-US` (one text for every recipient, as `notify` documents); a per-run locale for them is not this card.
